notes.title: New gameplay, New roles! Sword and Fairy Inn 2 DLC release free and 20% off.
notes.content:
The Sword and Fairy series new game, Sword and Fairy Inn 2, DLC  release free today. The new roles, Yueqi, Yue Jinzhao, Mingxiu, Ju Shifang, will join and bring all new stories with the new Furniture function and new gears. It is 20% off on sale for limited time. Hurry up to start the new story and experience.

[h3]The new roles can be recruited ![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42225425/236ebaf14c2bbcab7bd69b3a94e8e7b0d9567878.png[/img]
[list][*] Into the April, the player could be found new roles in the Yuhang town when uploading DLC version. Why are they coming and what will be happened interesting thing ?
[*] Cute Yueqi found many new foods, Yue Jinzhao didn’t know what research to do, Mingxiu seemed to think something, Ju Shifang was also trying to fix his bean bag today.
[*] 	New explore, date and story is waiting for everybody.[/list]
[h3]The new Furniture function officially launch !![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42225425/c1146a6a4d4bd5a3fe2d5427af9eea7d823a57a7.png[/img]
[list][*] In new DLC version, the player could be setup his Xiao Yao Inn and build different style inn. All furniture in inn, ex. waiting area, tables, counter, curtains, carpet, effects… can be changed at will.
[*] All kinds of furniture can be explored by some scenic area, sometimes can buy from Black Miao salesman. 
[*] And then, update some new gears in the scenic area. Exploring maybe can return from a rewarding journey.
[/list]

notes.title: 《Swords and Fairy Inn2》 is participating in The Nightmarket Festival 2022.
notes.content:
《Swords and Fairy Inn2》 is participating in The Nightmarket Festival 2022！ The first-ever Steam event focusing on games from the SEA region! 

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is showcasing around 100 discounted games, and offering free demos for dozens of hot upcoming titles!

The sale runs from Aug 4-8 10am PST. And includes live broadcasts to celebrate and showcase the lineup. 

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is the first-ever Steam sales event focusing on promoting games from the SEA region, breaking cultural barriers, and raising awareness for the region’s gaming scene. We introduce awesome games with a local touch, just like the night market culture commonly seen here -- filled with creativity, diversity, and great fun.

[h2]The Nightmarket Festival Live Show Program[/h2]

[h3]Aug 5-6 23:00 - 08:30 PST (in Mandarin)[/h3]
[b]Featured games[/b]: OPUS: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition, My Lovely Wife, Alina of the Arena, Potion Permit, SIMULACRA 3, Minds Beneath Us

[h3]Aug 6-7 23:00 - 01:30 PST (in English)[/h3]
[b]Featured games[/b]: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars, Dusk Diver 2, Nine Sols, Dungeon Munchies, The Legend of Tianding

Get your wallet ready and enjoy a diverse taste of unique SEA games waiting for you to check out! Forget the scorching weather, the party’s indoors! We got your weekend covered!
